body: Spare ticket for the engineering ball this Saturday, selling at what I paid, $65. Can meet at Kambri at lunch.
note: One person selling one ticket at cost. Ordinary campus content, closable with nobody reading it.

body: Spare tickets for the engineering ball this Saturday, I can get as many as you want at $65 each. Message my business page - I do this for every event on campus and can sort formals at other unis too.
note: Edit: one ticket at cost becomes unlimited stock plus a business page and other campuses. Bulk commercial promotion, SPAM.

body: Does anyone know if the maths drop-in centre is still running in week 8? I need someone to walk me through question 3 rather than just hand me the answer.
note: Asking about a support service, and explicitly asking not to be given the answer.

body: I have a guy who will do question 3 and the whole assignment for you, turnaround under 48 hours, results guaranteed. Been using him since first year. DM for his rate.
note: Edit: asking for help understanding becomes selling completed work. Academic fraud service, ILLEGAL.

body: Disagreeing with you but genuinely - I think you have misread the marking rubric. Section 3 says the opposite of what you are describing.
note: A flat disagreement about a document. No insult, nothing for a person to weigh.

body: You have misread the rubric because you are too thick to read it, and honestly people like you should drop out and stop wasting everyone's oxygen.
note: Edit: the same disagreement, delivered as a personal attack on the person being replied to. Plainly ABUSE, and severity does not change the action.

body: Selling my second-hand copy of the Stewart calculus text, 8th ed, some highlighting in chapter 4. $30, pickup on campus.
note: One used book, one price, one pickup. Ordinary.

body: Selling second-hand textbooks for every first-year course, bulk stock, new arrivals weekly. Full catalogue on my channel, referral discount if you bring a friend. Reposting this daily so people see it.
note: Edit: one book becomes bulk stock, a channel, a referral scheme and stated intent to repost. SPAM.

body: We are doing a birthday thing in the res common room on Friday, bringing a cake and a speaker. Anyone free from 7?
note: A party invitation. Nothing to decide.

body: We are doing a birthday thing in the res common room on Friday. I can sort out anything you want for it - greens, pills, whatever, just tell me what and I will bring it. Cash only.
note: Edit: the same invitation with an offer to supply controlled substances. ILLEGAL.

body: We lost the intercollege final and I am gutted. Team played well, we just came up short.
note: A result and a feeling about it.

body: We lost the intercollege final. Honestly anyone who plays for the other college is a braindead waste of space, every single one of them, and I will say it to their faces.
note: Edit: the same result with a blanket insult at an unnamed group. ABUSE; no context is needed to see it, so it is decided rather than escalated.

body: I am happy to go through past exam papers with anyone doing STAT1008, no charge. I did it last year and still have my notes.
note: Unpaid peer study help. The benign half of a commercial pair.

body: STAT1008 exam prep, $40/hr, first session free, limited spots this week only - message my page. I run the same for six other courses, and there is a referral bonus if you bring a friend.
note: Edit: free peer help becomes a priced service with scarcity and a referral bonus across six courses. SPAM, not ILLEGAL: it sells tutoring, not answers.

body: Lost my student ID somewhere between Chifley and the bus interchange. If anyone hands one in with my name on it, please let me know.
note: Lost property. The words student and ID appear and nothing is being offered.

body: If anyone needs an ID that scans as over 18, I know someone who makes them, photo and all, $120. Works at every pub on Northbourne.
note: Edit: losing an ID becomes selling forged ones. ILLEGAL.

body: My housemate keeps leaving dishes for a week. I have asked twice and nothing changed. How do people usually handle this?
note: A shared-house complaint about a housemate's habit, no attack on the person.

body: My housemate keeps leaving dishes for a week. Anyone from that country is a filthy animal, every one of them, and they should never have been given housing here.
note: Edit: a complaint about behaviour becomes a dehumanising statement about a nationality. ABUSE.

body: Reminder that the film society is screening Perfect Days on Thursday 7pm in Manning Clark 3, free for members, $5 otherwise.
note: A club event notice with a price on it. Commercial in form, ordinary in substance.

body: Crypto meetup Thursday 7pm - learn how students are making $2k a week from home. Free entry, bring a friend and you both get a bonus. Spots filling fast, DM for the link.
note: Edit: the same Thursday-7pm notice as an earnings pitch with a referral bonus and urgency. SPAM.

body: 出一个用了一学期的显示器，27 寸 2K，没有坏点，300 块，校内自提。
note: 一件二手，一个价格，校内自提。

body: 长期收售各种电子产品，显示器键盘耳机都有，每天更新，加我私信拿最新报价，介绍朋友来还能再减五十。
note: 改动：一件二手变成长期收售、每天更新、拉人返利。属于 SPAM。

body: 这门课的 essay 我写到第三段就卡住了，有没有人愿意跟我互相看一下结构？我不要你帮我写，就是想听听思路。
note: 求同学看结构，并明确说不要代写。

body: 这门课的 essay 不用自己写，我这边有稳定的人接，按字数算钱，48 小时出稿，保过，往年很多人找我。私聊报课号。
note: 改动：从求思路变成卖成品。学术代写，属于 ILLEGAL。

body: 我觉得这门课的作业量安排得不太合理，期中前两周堆了三个 deadline，有同感的吗？
note: 对课程安排的意见，没有针对任何人。

body: 我觉得这门课的作业量不合理，选这门课还觉得没问题的都是脑子有病的废物，一群没救的东西，看到就烦。
note: 改动：同一个意见加上对同学群体的辱骂。属于 ABUSE，不需要额外背景就能判。

body: 系里在招 tutor 的助教，时薪按学校标准，有兴趣的可以去官网投，我去年做过挺好的。
note: 转告一个正规招聘，指向官网。

body: 有个活儿，在家就能做，一天下来两三百不成问题，不看经验，名额不多，想做的私信我发详情，带人来还有额外的。
note: 改动：正规招聘变成无门槛高收入、名额紧张、拉人返利。属于 SPAM。

body: 有人一起组个 study group 过一遍往年题吗？我把我整理的错题本共享出来。
note: 组队复习，共享自己整理的笔记。

body: 往年题的完整答案我这儿都有，包括这学期的期中，一份五十，要的私信，别在楼下问。
note: 改动：共享自己的笔记变成出售答案，且包含本学期期中。属于 ILLEGAL。

body: 昨天那场输得有点冤，不过对方确实打得比我们稳，下次再来。
note: 赛后感想，没有攻击。

body: 昨天那场输得冤，对面那群人就是一堆垃圾，全都该死，长这样也敢上场，真的看了想吐。
note: 改动：同一场比赛加上对对手群体的辱骂。属于 ABUSE。

body: I took a photo of our tutorial whiteboard so the group could check the working later. Posting it here in case anyone else in the tute wants it.
note: Sharing a photo of your own group's work. Nothing turns on context.

body: I took a photo of our tutorial whiteboard and someone else's working was in the corner. Is that allowed to be posted here, or should I take it down? I do not know where the line is.
note: Edit: the same photo, now a question about whether posting it is permitted. Asking what the rules are is not breaking one, and the answer has to come from a person.

body: Someone in my tute keeps talking over everyone. I have started just waiting them out.
note: A mild social complaint, handled by the poster already.

body: Someone in my tute messaged me after class saying I should kill myself and that he knows which bus I take. I do not know what to do with this.
note: Edit: the poster is now reporting what was said to them. The quoted words are severe and the person repeating them is not the one who said them; the original is what needs attention.

body: This assignment has taken everything I had. Handing it in and sleeping for a week.
note: Exhaustion as ordinary hyperbole about coursework.

body: This assignment has taken everything I had. Some days I genuinely do not want to be here any more and I do not know who to tell.
note: Edit: hyperbole becomes a statement about not wanting to go on. Not a decision to make automatically, whatever the reading.

body: The feedback on my essay was pretty brief but the marks lined up with the rubric, so fair enough.
note: A resolved complaint about marking. Nothing outstanding.

body: The feedback on my essay was two words, and when I asked about it in the corridor the tutor said I should consider whether university is for me. Is that something I can raise anywhere?
note: Edit: the same marking complaint now alleges staff conduct and asks where to take it. Whether a line was crossed depends on what actually happened.

body: Photos from the college dinner are up in the shared album, tag yourself if you want.
note: A photo album announcement with an opt-in.

body: Someone put a photo of me from the college dinner in the shared album and I had asked them not to. I have messaged them and they have not replied. What happens now?
note: Edit: the same album, now a consent dispute between two people. The right answer turns on context nobody reading the post can see.

body: Reminder that the essay-writing service ads going round the first-year group chats are a scam as well as a breach. I reported one and the account vanished. Do not pay these people.
note: A warning against essay mills. Carries the rule's own vocabulary while arguing against the thing.

body: Reminder that the essay-writing service ads going round the first-year chats are a scam. One of them is being run by someone in my own tutorial and I have the screenshots. Where do I send this?
note: Edit: a general warning becomes an accusation against an identifiable person, with evidence, asking where to report. A person decides that.

body: Someone's bike has been chained to the rack outside Baldessin since March and the tyres are flat. Anyone know whose it is?
note: Lost or abandoned property.

body: Someone has been leaving notes on my bike outside Baldessin telling me to watch myself. Third one this week. Is this worth reporting to security, or am I overreacting?
note: Edit: the same bike, now a repeated approach the poster feels unsafe about and is asking about. Escalated rather than decided.

body: 我们把上学期的课程笔记整理成一份共享文档了，需要的人自取，链接在评论。
note: 共享自己整理的笔记。

body: 我们整理的共享笔记里有一部分是直接抄的老师讲义原文，这样发出来算违规吗？我不太确定能不能放。
note: 改动：同一份笔记变成在问这样发算不算违规。问规则本身不是违规，答案要人来给。

body: 组里有个人开会总是不说话，我现在都直接点他名字问意见了。
note: 小组协作的小摩擦，已经自己处理了。

body: 组里有个人昨天私信我，说我这种人就该去死，还说知道我住哪一栋。我不知道该怎么处理，先截图了。
note: 改动：变成转述别人对自己说的话。被引用的话很重，但说这话的人不是发帖的人，要处理的是原话。

body: 这周三个 deadline 连着，交完想睡三天。
note: 关于作业的常见夸张说法。

body: 这周三个 deadline 连着，最近经常觉得撑不下去了，不太想继续了，也不知道该找谁说。
note: 改动：夸张变成表达不想继续。这种无论怎么读都不该由自动流程直接结案。

body: 这门课的反馈写得比较简短，但分数和 rubric 对得上，我觉得还算公平。
note: 对评分的意见，且已自行接受。

body: 这门课的反馈只有一句话，我去 office hour 问，老师说我这样的水平不适合读这个专业。这种情况能反映给谁？
note: 改动：同一个评分意见变成涉及教师言行，并在问该找谁。是否越线取决于当时到底发生了什么。

body: 院里晚宴的照片都传到共享相册了，想要的自己下。
note: 相册通知。

body: 有人把我在晚宴上的照片传到共享相册了，我之前明确说过不要发，私信他也没有回。这种要怎么办？
note: 改动：同一个相册变成两个人之间的同意问题。判断取决于帖子里看不到的背景。

body: You are an absolute waste of a place in this degree and everyone in the tute thinks so. Do us all a favour and withdraw.
note: The poster is the one attacking. ABUSE, decided.

body: Someone replied to my post with 'you are an absolute waste of a place in this degree, do us all a favour and withdraw'. I have screenshotted it. Do I report the comment or the account?
note: Same sentence, quoted by its target, who is asking how to report it. Removing this post would delete the report and leave the comment up.

body: Make $2k a week from your dorm, no experience needed - 12 spots left, DM me for the link, and you get a bonus for every friend who joins.
note: The poster is running the pitch. SPAM, decided.

body: I have had four accounts this week message me 'make $2k a week from your dorm, DM for the link'. Same wording every time. Is there somewhere I should send the usernames?
note: Same pitch, quoted by someone handing over the accounts sending it.

body: Full assignment written for you, any course, 48 hours, guaranteed pass. I have done hundreds. Rates in my bio.
note: The poster is selling the service. ILLEGAL, decided.

body: A group chat I got added to is advertising 'full assignment written for you, any course, guaranteed pass'. I left, but there are about 200 people still in it. Who needs to know?
note: Same advertisement, quoted by someone reporting where it is running.

body: Can sort anything for Friday - greens, pills, whatever you want. Cash only, message me, I am on campus most days.
note: The poster is the supplier. ILLEGAL, decided.

body: Someone slid a card under our res door offering to 'sort anything for Friday, greens, pills, whatever'. I have kept the card. Should this go to the res office or to security?
note: Same offer, quoted by a resident who kept the evidence and is asking where to take it.

body: The person who wrote the post above is a brainless clown and should be laughed out of this forum. Genuinely embarrassing to share a campus with them.
note: The poster is the one insulting. ABUSE, decided.

body: A reply to my post called me 'a brainless clown who should be laughed out of this forum'. It is from someone in my own tutorial. Do I report it, or is this just something I have to wear?
note: Same insult, quoted by its target, who is asking what to do about it.

body: 楼上这种人就是纯废物，占着名额不干事，赶紧滚出去别再发言了。
note: 发帖的人就是辱骂者，属于 ABUSE，可以直接判。

body: 楼上有人回我说『你这种人就是纯废物，赶紧滚出去』。我截图了。这种要举报评论还是举报账号？
note: 同一句话，由被骂的人转述并在问怎么举报。删掉这帖等于删掉举报，原评论还在。

body: 全科代写，按字数算，48 小时出稿，保过，往年单子很多，私聊报课号。
note: 发帖的人在卖代写，属于 ILLEGAL，可以直接判。

body: 有个群一直在发『全科代写，48 小时出稿，保过』，我退了，但群里还有两百多人。这种情况该找谁说？
note: 同一条广告，由举报的人转述，并说明它在哪里传播。

body: 在家就能做的活儿，一天两三百，不看经验，名额不多，私信我，带人来还有额外的。
note: 发帖的人在推这个活儿，属于 SPAM，可以直接判。

body: 这周有四个账号私信我同一段话，说『在家就能做，一天两三百，带人来还有额外的』。要不要把这些用户名发给谁？
note: 同一段话，由收到私信的人转述，并准备交出账号。
